detail.longDescription:
LikeClaw is the AI agent platform that actually does things — securely, instantly, and affordably.

No 3-day setup. No security nightmares. No surprise bills. Start free with 50 tasks/month.

WHAT MAKES LIKECLAW DIFFERENT

Execute Code Safely
Run code in sandboxed environments — no raw system access, no malware risk. Your files stay isolated and encrypted.

Multi-Model AI, One App
Choose Claude, GPT-4, DeepSeek in seconds. Stop paying $20 + $20 + $20 to different AI companies. Use all of them in one subscription.

Skills Marketplace (0 Malware Guarantee)
Extend with vetted automations. Every skill is security-reviewed before publishing. Unlike OpenClaw, zero malware.

WHY LIKECLAW

vs OpenClaw:
✓ Cloud-native, no installation
✓ Secure by design (sandboxed, not raw access)
✓ Transparent pricing (no surprise token bills)
✓ Managed service (we handle infrastructure)
✓ Mobile-accessible

vs ChatGPT:
✓ Actually automates tasks (not just chat)
✓ Executes code in real-time
✓ Multi-model support
✓ Persistent workspaces
✓ Task-focused, not conversational

USE CASES

💼 Productivity: Email sorting, scheduling, calendar management
🛠️ Development: Safe code execution, DevOps tasks, debugging
✨ Creative: Asset generation, bulk media processing
⚡ Automation: APIs, data transformation, workflows
🔒 Security: Code auditing, penetration testing, log analysis

FEATURES

✓ AI Code Executor — Python, JavaScript, Bash in secure sandboxes
✓ Multi-Model AI — Claude, GPT-4, DeepSeek in one place
✓ Skills Marketplace — Vetted, secure automations
✓ Persistent Workspaces — AI remembers your context
✓ File System & Storage — Save outputs, access files
✓ 30-Second Setup — Email signup, instant use
✓ Enterprise Security — SOC 2 compliant, E2B isolation
✓ Transparent Pricing — Credits, no mystery bills
✓ Free Tier — 50 tasks/month, all core features

PRICING

Free: 50 tasks/mo, basic models, 1 workspace
Pro: $15–20/mo → Unlimited chat, 500 executions, all models
Power: $40/mo → Unlimited everything, BYOK, priority

PERFECT FOR

→ Developers switching from ChatGPT, Claude, or OpenClaw
→ Anyone frustrated with "talks about code" vs "executes code"
→ Teams automating tasks without hiring engineers
→ Creators processing media at scale
→ Anyone tired of surprise AI bills

WHY TRUST US

Security First: Sandboxed execution, not raw system access
Vetting: Zero malware in our skills marketplace
Transparent Pricing: Predictable credits, not runaway bills
Built by AI Engineers: We know the gaps in existing tools
Active Community: Founders answer support tickets personally

GET STARTED

1. Install LikeClaw on Google Play
2. Sign up with email (30 seconds)
3. Choose a task: write code, automate, generate
4. Watch AI execute in real-time
5. Build complex agents with our marketplace

No credit card for first 50 tasks.

Join our community for tips, skills, and support.

Made for people tired of AI tools that just talk.
